assets.description: Cream warehouse, two unobstructed front bays, stepped oxide roof. Doors lift independently; roof vent fan and rear pallet lift.
Yellow garage with wide front bay, lifting steel service door and slow roof vent fan.
Olive hopper with short dark belt emerging at front; twin rollers and batch magnet sweep gantry.
Oxide furnace with open amber mouth, tall chimney, side cooling fan, pour spout and sparse vent puff.
Olive generator with visible cream fan in charcoal frame, drive shaft and start/load/spin-down channels.

Production mobile crane rig: 3x3 base, slewing tower/boom with counterweight and operator cab, hoist cable with opening grip claws. Slew/hoist/grip/place channels; suspended load never grounds. Forward +Z.
Production truck rig: cream cab with opening side doors, oxide bed with folding tailgate and brake lights, six rolling wheels (front pair steers), body suspension and cargo-load channels. Forward +Z.
Production forklift rig: yellow body, charcoal mast with tilting carriage and spreading forks, operator seat/roof, four rolling wheels. Parked forks lowered. Forward +Z.

Production cargo drone rig: four spinning rotors on cross arms, landing skids, beacon mast, and a load group carrying the crate (attach/lower channel). Takeoff/landing flight height is an entity transform. Forward +Z.
Production worker rig: grounded boots, hi-vis vest, hard hat, and a weld torch on the right arm. Walk (anti-phase limbs), carry, operate and weld channels; rest pose waits. Forward +Z.
Olive kinetic defense turret with separate yaw mount and pitch barrel.
Original modular wall gate; friendly road passage opens center.
Sectioned wreck husk for salvage landmarks: dead hull, cab and bed sections with scattered debris. Static; reveal stages owned by #169.
